note: Steep oak-hickory hills, all forested, west of Kirksville. MDC's one primitive camping spot is beside the gravel parking lot on Montgomery Woods Trail; no amenities. Walk-in camping elsewhere on the area is closed during the firearms deer and turkey seasons. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: one map/GIS-designated primitive camping spot beside the single gravel lot (GIS 385, under canopy 46 m NW of lot 849). Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Pin move onto the lot suggested; phone matches; not waterfront kept.
flags: INCLUSION OK: area page 'Things to Do: Camping: Designated Camping Sites' (plus 'Open Camping-Walk/Float/Backpack (no Deer/Turkey)'); brochure 'Camping is allowed on or adjacent to all area parking lots.'; the map (12/14/2021) has one 'Primitive Camping' symbol beside its one Parking Lot; GIS 27 point 385. Rule 140 standard; no special-use-only rule, no Rule 101.

PIN: stored 40.04094,-92.83279 = GIS 385, in open leafless woods 46 m NW of lot 849 (40.04056,-92.83255) with no track to it. Suggest 40.04060,-92.83260 on the lot, a ~35 x 30 m gravel pad straight off the gravel Montgomery Woods Trail (0.75 mi off Highway 11). A 23-ft rig reaches it; no ford or posted limit.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept; no water by the lot (a small pond lies ~100 m SE across the road, off the area).
HORSES: none. CLUSTERS: one camping spot.

Season (year-round, manual) left: the brochure's deer/turkey-season exception applies to walk-in/backpack camping only ('Walk-in/backpack camping is allowed EXCEPT during all firearms deer and turkey seasons'), not the lot spot.
